advisoryFindings.title: Clarify artifact write failure case
advisoryFindings.rationale: The current case still exercises a production artifact-write failure path through `context.artifacts.writeJson`, so it does not leave the requirement uncovered.
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider naming or commenting that the artifact write failure case is a rejected artifact-path write, or add a second case for an underlying filesystem write failure if that distinction matters to the implementation.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current case still exercises a production artifact-write failure path through `context.artifacts.writeJson`, so it does not leave the requirement uncovered.
